profile.summary: ACC Environmental Consultants, Inc. is an employee-owned environmental consulting firm founded in 1986. It provides asbestos and lead consulting, mold and indoor air quality testing, site assessments, hazardous materials management and industrial hygiene services. It serves clients in California, Oregon and Washington.
